meta.title: Memory Archive
meta.description: Keep the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you. Everything stays on this device.

welcome.title: Keep their words close
welcome.body: Bring together the conversations, photos and voice messages of the people who matter to you, and open them again whenever you want.
welcome.privacy: Everything stays on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
welcome.openHint: Already have a Memory Archive file? Open it to continue where you left off.
welcome.comingSoon: This step is not ready yet. It will arrive in a coming version.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the app. Your messages are never translated.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Memory Archive works without an internet connection once it is open. Nothing you add leaves this device unless you export it yourself.

storage.title: Space on this device
storage.usage: {used} used of about {total} available to this app
storage.unknown: This browser does not say how much space the app uses.
storage.persisted: Your archive is protected: the browser will not delete it on its own.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may clear this app’s data if the device runs out of space. Adding the app to your home screen helps keep it safe, and so does exporting a copy from time to time.

import.title: Received files
import.none: Nothing has been shared with Memory Archive yet. In WhatsApp, open a chat, choose Export chat and share it with Memory Archive.
import.next: They are kept on this device. Adding them to the archive will be possible in a coming version.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: This page has not been saved on this device yet. The pages you already opened keep working without a connection.
